title: Reconcile competing story heads
statement: As a developer resolving concurrent story edits, I can reconcile every competing head into one complete revision so the story becomes current without erasing either branch's history.

acceptance_criteria.statement: When a story has competing revision heads, a reconciliation that omits any current head is rejected without creating a revision.
A complete revision naming every current revision head becomes the sole current revision, while the former heads remain visible in requirement history.
